title: Define homebrew manifest section contract
summary: Extend the package-manager manifest contract (from status-distribution-and-sdk-ecosystem-add-package-manager-manifest-contract) with a homebrew-specific manifest section: schema, empty placeholders, and a validator hook so future homebrew formula evidence can be checked deterministically. Publication and signing remain human-owned.
expectedFailureModes: Homebrew manifest section ships without a schema validator and drifts into machine-local paths.
docs/status.md overclaims homebrew formula availability before publication custody is decided.
Validator hook is added but not wired into validate.sh --scripts, so regressions slip past CI.
humanEscalation: Homebrew tap publication, formula custody, and signing keys remain human-owned.
nextAction: Add a homebrew section to the package-manager manifest schema with required fields, emit empty placeholders, register a validator hook, and document the contract in docs/distribution-readiness.md without claiming homebrew is shipping.
